_documentation.description: Add your own offline games or software targets to `targets` below, then run `update_progress.bat` (or `python Tools_and_Scripts/rpg_manager.py`). The 5-Axis Rubric Calculator will automatically compute the objective Difficulty (0.1 - 10.0) and RPG Tier (F- to SSS++) so no one can artificially inflate an easy program to SSS++!

arch_symbols.0.2: White-box source / Plaintext config / Full PDB symbols
arch_symbols.0.5: Simple 32-bit/64-bit native desktop binary or .NET/Java with full symbols
arch_symbols.0.9: Standard Unity Mono / C# XNA / GameMaker / Scripting VM with metadata
arch_symbols.1.4: Stripped x86/x64 Native C++ binary (no symbols)
arch_symbols.1.7: Transpiled Unity IL2CPP / Embedded LuaJIT / Mixed-mode native+managed
arch_symbols.2.0: Cross-Architecture Console Emulator (Big-Endian PowerPC, ARM64, PS3 Cell, MIPS) or Custom CPU

memory_indirection.0.1: Static global variables or 1D/2D fixed array
memory_indirection.0.8: Dynamic linked lists, hash maps, or procedural room state
memory_indirection.1.2: Deep C++ OOP polymorphism, VMTs, Source Netvars, or Unreal GWorld/FNamePool hierarchy
memory_indirection.1.7: Data-Oriented Design (SoA slabs), custom memory allocators, pure ECS, or 64-bit planetary coords
memory_indirection.2.0: XOR/Encrypted runtime values in RAM or ephemeral VM stack registers

engine_complexity.0.8: Shared damage/update engine code requiring entity/team filtering
engine_complexity.1.2: 3D Vector math, ViewMatrix 4x4 WorldToScreen, and skeletal bone matrices
engine_complexity.1.6: Internal DLL Trampoline/VMT hooking, DX11/DX12/Vulkan ImGui overlay, or custom SDK generation
engine_complexity.2.0: Byte-accurate matching decompilation or automated LLVM IR binary lifting

binary_protection.0.5: Basic user-mode anti-debug checks (IsDebuggerPresent, PEB, 0xCC scan)
binary_protection.1.2: Commercial packer (UPX, SecuROM) or .text CRC32 integrity verification threads (Arxan)
binary_protection.1.8: Custom Bytecode Virtual Machine, O-LLVM Control-Flow Flattening (CFF), or MBA obfuscation
binary_protection.2.5: Commercial Virtualizer (VMProtect, Themida) or hardware crypto dongle

privilege_boundary.0.7: Custom encrypted binary network protocol emulation (Blowfish/RSA packet crafting)
privilege_boundary.1.5: Ring-0 Kernel Driver, QEMU/KVM Hypervisor VMI (CR3 page table walk), EPT hooking, or Silicon glitching

targets.title: Balatro (Offline Deckbuilder)
targets.quest: Unpack the LÖVE2D archive appended to `Balatro.exe`, inspect Lua state variables (`G.GAME.dollars`, `G.GAME.chips`), and hook chip multiplier scoring.

targets.title: KeePass 2.x (KDBX v4 Vault Format Audit)
targets.quest: Audit how `KeePass.exe` parses the KDBX 4.0 binary header, Argon2d/AES-256-CBC key derivation parameters, and DPAPI protected in-memory strings (`ProtectedBinary`).
